verdict_definitions.VALIDATED: Measured or reproducible and proven on evidence we can open. Not a promise of future accuracy — a claim we can show our work on today.
verdict_definitions.PROVISIONAL: Observed but not yet proven. In shadow, below a maturation gate, or awaiting review. We publish it here rather than wait for it to look better.
verdict_definitions.DEPRECATED: Superseded by a better approach and no longer the shipped path. Kept on the record so the history is legible.
verdict_definitions.REJECTED: Tried and turned down — the labels can't train it, or it failed a gate. A published failure, not a hidden one.

entries.name: MLB Projection (H+P / Marcel)
entries.verdict_reason: Beats internal baselines on held-out data but has not yet beaten Steamer; the live forward check is running and currently losing, below the maturation gate.

entries.name: Prospect Rank v1
entries.verdict_reason: Calibration is under review and coverage is still candidate-stage; the board ships, the proof is not yet in.

entries.name: Peak Projection v1
entries.verdict_reason: A role and skill-shape projection under active calibration review, not a validated stat forecast.

entries.name: Universal Prospect Model
entries.verdict_reason: Observed in shadow only — backtested but not promoted to a validated verdict.

entries.name: MiLB Translation
entries.verdict_reason: A deterministic, reproducible level-translation port — measured, observe-only, and never a value input.

entries.name: Shape Comps
entries.verdict_reason: Deterministic and reproducible — the closest real MLB shapes on three translated rates, measured not modeled.

entries.name: Pitch Discipline — exact metrics
entries.verdict_reason: Swing/Whiff/SwStr counted directly from play-by-play, ProspectSavant-matched — observe-only, never a value input.

entries.name: Pitch Discipline — estimated zone metrics
entries.verdict_reason: Zone rates from a pixel-coordinate calibration, tagged "est." — held-out agreement clears the bar but they are estimates, not measurements.

entries.name: Ahead-of-the-Curve divergence calls
entries.verdict_reason: A live, pre-registered call ledger with the sample still maturing toward its published horizon — open the ledger for the current number.

entries.name: Wins (W) target
entries.verdict_reason: There is no W in the label seasons, so a W-inclusive preset hits the partial-coverage refusal — ValuCast cannot train a W target and does not fake one.
